2. GCD(81,27). Binary algorithm: 81 mod 27 = 0? Actually 81/27=3 remainder 0. So gcd=27. But binary algorithm would also yield 27.

3. LCM(15,25). Standard: lcm = (15*25)/gcd(15,25). gcd(15,25)=5. So lcm = (375)/5=75.

4. LCM(21,14). Reduced algorithm: lcm = (21*14)/gcd(21,14). gcd(21,14)=7. So lcm = (294)/7=42.

Thus results: 14, 27, 75, 42.
